customer_question: The account in our registration confirmation document doesn't have our Qualification Fee Receipt Number attached to it. How do we get the Receipt Number associated with the right account so registration can proceed?
question_variants: Why isn't our Receipt Number showing up under this registration account?
How do we move a Receipt Number to a different account?
Who needs to do what to complete a Transfer Request?
actual_issue: After logging into the account named in the customer's registration confirmation document, it was found that the Qualification Fee's Receipt Number was not attached to that account, since the Receipt Number had instead been issued to the account used when the Invoice was originally obtained -- a different account from the one intended for the registration.
plain_english_explanation: When you pay for Bluetooth certification, the payment receipt gets tied to whichever account was logged in at the time, not necessarily the account that ends up doing the actual registration later. If those two accounts are different, the registration can't just proceed -- the receipt has to be formally transferred to the right account first, and that requires the original account's owner to approve the move.
consultant_answer: After logging in with the account from the registration confirmation document, it was confirmed that the Qualification Fee's Receipt Number was not attached to this account. A Transfer Request was issued to move the Receipt Number to the correct account. The holder of the account used when the Invoice was originally obtained will receive an email from SIG containing a link to accept the Transfer Request, and the customer was asked to have that account holder complete the Accept action via that link.
decision_logic: Before proceeding with a registration, confirm by logging in that the Qualification Fee's Receipt Number is actually attached to the account intended for registration; if it is attached to a different account instead (such as the one used to obtain the Invoice), the correct remedy is a SIG Transfer Request, which must be accepted by the original account holder via the link SIG sends them, rather than attempting to proceed with the mismatched account.
final_recommendation: When a registration confirmation document's account does not have the Qualification Fee's Receipt Number attached, issue a SIG Transfer Request and instruct the customer to have the original Invoice account holder accept it via the emailed link before proceeding with registration.
risk_if_done_wrong: Attempting to proceed with registration without confirming the Receipt Number is attached to the correct account would block the registration from finalizing until the mismatch is found and resolved, and skipping the Transfer Request's required acceptance step would leave the Receipt Number unusable for the intended registration account.
